page.title: Two-way subscription and bill sync for Firefly III
page.lede: Use Coinio’s calendar, reminders, AI MCP server and widgets while keeping your Firefly III bills and withdrawal transactions up to date automatically every 15 minutes.
page.checked: Built into Coinio 0.3 · Works on self-hosted and hosted instances over HTTPS.
sync.title: What stays in sync
sync.lede: Coinio maps subscriptions directly to Firefly III bills—keeping your ledger safe from duplicates or accidental deletions.
r.defs.coinio: Name, price, currency, cycle, active status and notes sync both ways.
r.defs.ff: Mapped to Firefly III Bills (not recurrences).
r.payments.coinio: Marking paid creates a linked withdrawal (with FX conversion if needed).
r.payments.ff: Transactions linked to a bill mark the closest Coinio period paid (±7 days).
r.auto.coinio: Checks ±7 days before writing; auto-charges wait 2 days for bank imports.
r.auto.ff: Bank CSV / Data Importer entries link cleanly instead of duplicating.
r.conflict.coinio: Last updated wins, tracked by synced-field hash so UI tweaks never overwrite.
r.conflict.ff: Only synced bill fields trigger updates.
r.delete.coinio: Never deletes records—removing on one side marks the other inactive.
r.delete.ff: Historical Firefly III transactions stay untouched.
steps.title: Connect in three steps
steps.lede: No webhooks needed—Firefly III does not need to reach Coinio.
steps.1: Generate a Personal Access Token in Firefly III under Options › Profile › OAuth.
steps.2: Paste your Firefly URL, token and default asset account in Settings › Integrations › Firefly III.
steps.3: Review the first-sync match preview, choose which bills to link, and sync every 15 minutes.
extra.title: Per-subscription accounts and safe network rules
extra.body: Override the default Firefly III asset account per subscription, sync across different currencies, and run safely behind Coinio’s private-network guard (COINIO_BLOCK_PRIVATE_NETWORKS on the hosted cloud).
pfaq.title: Firefly III sync questions
pfaq.how.q: How does Coinio connect to Firefly III?
pfaq.how.a: With a Personal Access Token over Firefly III’s REST API v1. There are no webhooks to expose, and your token is never returned to the browser.
pfaq.duplicates.q: Will Coinio create duplicate withdrawal transactions?
pfaq.duplicates.a: Before creating a transaction, Coinio checks the bill for an existing transaction within ±7 days. Automatic payments in Coinio also wait 2 days before pushing so your bank import arrives first.
pfaq.delete.q: What happens if I delete a subscription or bill?
pfaq.delete.a: Coinio never deletes records in Firefly III or Coinio during sync. Deleting on one side marks the linked entry inactive on the other and preserves all past transaction links.
pfaq.hosted.q: Can I use Firefly III sync on app.getcoinio.me?
pfaq.hosted.a: Yes, as long as your Firefly III instance is reachable over a public HTTPS address. For local LAN instances, self-host Coinio on the same network.
pfaq.recurrences.q: Does it sync Firefly III recurring transactions?
pfaq.recurrences.a: No—Coinio syncs with Firefly III Bills only, which match recurring subscription commitments and linked payments cleanly.
